newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech PX50 falls but unaffected by Dow - dealers.
newsitem.headline: Czech PX50 falls but unaffected by Dow - dealers.

text.p: 1400 GMT - The Czech PX50 closes lower on Monday but analysts say Friday's falls on the Dow are not to blame.
* PX50 down one point, 0.19 percent, to 537.8.
* Reuters Prague Real-time index drops 3.8 points, 0.34 percent, to 1,128.
* Overall, 107 shares rise, 61 fall, 47 unchanged. Volume, 923,907 shares, turnover, 1.2 billion crowns.
The Czech PX50 closed slightly lower on Monday, with most analysts saying the domestic market was unlikely to be significantly affeceted by Friday's sharp losses on Wall Street.

"We are undivided in our opinion that you normally don't find the same sort of people trading in the west and these sort of markets..I really don't see any influence from Wall Street," said Radek Vavra of Citicorp Securities.
Jakub Dyba, a broker at CS First Boston agreed: "The correlation of the indices of the Czech Republic and Wall Street is probably the lowest in eastern Europe."
Dyba added that some of the major issues had lost ground for fundamental reasons.
"We are seeing profit taking. Komercni Banka is fundamentally very expensive," he said.
Komercni was the biggest high cap decliner of the day, losing 45 crowns to 1,845. SPT Telecom and CE, which both fell heavily earlier in the session, closed unchanged from Friday.
Overall, activity was relatively high with total turnover at almost 1.2 billion crowns.
